subject_identity_preserved.rationale: A central skateboarder in dark clothing with light arms and pink/purple footwear persists across the sequence, though shot 0 is cropped and shot 5 is close/blurred enough to reduce certainty.

background_coherent.rationale: The tan skate bowl, blue coping/fence, trees, and painted bowl sections remain coherent across shots, consistent with one skatepark event.

per_shot_adherence.issue: Low near-concrete view and left-to-right rolling are plausible, but the rider is heavily cropped.
Side/tracking carve up the wall is broadly matched, with some board/body artifacting.
The ollie is visible, but the view is not clearly overhead and the landing is not shown in this single frame.
Behind-rider follow toward a painted wall with a lean into a turn is well matched.
Crossing the bowl at speed is plausible, but the view is not strongly telephoto and there is noticeable ghosting/duplicate-board artifacting.
Front three-quarter close view is present, but the frame shows an airborne/unstable trick moment rather than clearly rolling out and steadying.

which_cut_broke.how: No single cut clearly breaks subject or place continuity; issues are mostly caption-adherence and motion/artifact problems rather than cross-shot inconsistency.

cheat_flags.rationale: Frames are distinct with changing rider pose, camera distance, and bowl sections; no copied/frozen sequence or collapsed single prompt is evident.
